## Build Training Around Real Work
#### Create realistic roleplay, onboarding, and scenario-based learning tied to the skills and outcomes your organization cares about.
### Start With One Use Case
Choose one conversation, decision, or onboarding moment. Launch a focused pilot, learn from real users, and expand when it works.
### No-Code Authoring
Build branching scenarios with a visual editor, so learning teams can create and update practice without writing code.
### Tailor Every Scenario
Start with 50+ templates or import your own 3D models, then shape the environment, content, AI interactions, and success criteria around your learners.
### Secure Access
Use secure access controls for internal training, customer education, or public learning experiences as your program grows.
### Improve With Evidence
Review learner choices, completion, and performance signals, then refine scenarios as skills, products, and processes change.
### Practice On Demand
Give learners repeatable access to onboarding, roleplay, and skills practice whenever they need it.
### One Learning Environment
Bring onboarding, instructor-led sessions, self-paced practice, and team learning into a connected experience.
![](https://epaouydin3q.exactdn.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Cross-Device.png?strip=all&lossy=1&ssl=1)
### Works Across Devices
Reach learners in the browser on smartphones, tablets, laptops, and VR or AR headsets, without requiring downloads or software installation.
![](https://epaouydin3q.exactdn.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/sso-gdpr-security.png?strip=all&lossy=1&ssl=1)
### Built for Enterprise
Support enterprise SSO, data privacy, security, and GDPR requirements while connecting training to the systems your organization already uses.
![](https://epaouydin3q.exactdn.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/partner_ecosystem-1.png?strip=all&lossy=1&ssl=1)
### 100+ Integrations
Connect Hyperspace with the learning, collaboration, content, and business tools your teams already use.
![](https://epaouydin3q.exactdn.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/cloud-scale-kubernetes-transparent.png?strip=all&lossy=1&ssl=1)
### Cloud Scale
Deliver reliable AI roleplay and onboarding programs across teams and locations on cloud infrastructure that scales with your audience.

Let learners rehearse customer, sales, leadership, and difficult conversations with AI avatars, receive guidance, and try again.

Build immersive branching scenarios for mobile, tablet, desktop, and VR or AR with a visual editor and no programming required.
